podcast.title: Evolution from Freak Baby (1985)
podcast.body: The band formed around Dave Grohl's 16th birthday in January 1985, evolving from Freak Baby. This marked Dave Grohl's transition to playing the drums. "Then Freak Baby morphed into Mission Impossible, which happened around Dave's 16th birthday in January of 1985. By this time, David moved to Drums"

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Opening for Fugazi
podcast.body: Mishmash Impossible managed to secure an opening slot for the DC punk band Fugazi on one occasion, highlighting a notable early achievement for the band that featured Dave Grohl on drums. "Mishmash Impossible, who actually managed to get an opening slot for DC's Fugazi ones."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Short-lived Tenure
podcast.body: The band lasted only a few months, disbanding when two of its members graduated from high school and left for college. "So within a few months, when two members graduated from high school and moved off to college, Mission Impossible came to an end"

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Split Single Partner (1985)
xref.body: This band shared a split 7-inch single with Mission Impossible, recorded in April 1985. Despite the release and later a name change, "nothing much happened." "The other band on the record was called Lunch Meat, but again, nothing much happened even after they changed their name too fast."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Transition to Drums (1985)
xref.body: Around his 16th birthday in January 1985, as Freak Baby evolved into Mission Impossible, Dave Grohl transitioned from guitar to playing the drums. "By this time, David moved to Drums, and this is where we finally get to Dave's earliest recordings that we can find."

xref.title: Extensive Movie and TV Soundtrack Work
xref.body: Carol Kaye's contributions extended to numerous movie soundtracks, including "The Thomas Crown Affair," "Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid," and at least one "Planet of the Apes" movie. She also played on themes for "Jerry Harry," "Wonder Woman," "Mash," "Mission Impossible," and "The Brady Bunch," showcasing her diverse work in film and television. "And I hadn't mentioned all the movie soundtracks, the Thomas Crown Affair, butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid, at least one planet of the Apes movie."

xref.title: Formation after Mission Impossible
xref.body: Dave Grohl formed Dane Bramage after Mission Impossible disbanded, marking his next musical venture. "Dave formed a new group called Dane Bramage."
